slides.text: Your AI agent is now a <accent>24/7 employee.</accent> Native cron-like scheduling built into <accent>Claude Code Desktop.</accent> Schedule any skill or workflow to run hourly, daily, or weekly. No external scripts. No extra setup. <accent>Just prompts.</accent>

slides.heading: Two Ways to <accent>Set It Up</accent>
slides.body:
- Desktop App > Schedule tab
- Set name, prompt, schedule
- Or type /schedule in session
- Claude handles the rest

slides.heading: Why This <accent>Changes</accent> Everything
before: Scripts hit errors and stop dead
after: Uses all your MCP tools and skills

slides.text: Every morning at 6am, my 'Good Morning Shaid' skill runs. It checks my calendar, reviews my projects, and plans my day. All before I wake up.

slides.heading: <accent>5</accent> Pro Tips
items: Run manually first to catch permission issues
Add a hook for sound notifications when tasks finish
Put 'notify me when done' in prompts for Slack alerts
Use one status file per task, not append logs
Deny destructive bash commands in project settings

slides.heading: Limitations to <accent>Know</accent>
items: Desktop app must be open (catches up if you miss runs)
Each run is stateless - use a status file for memory
Lock down destructive commands in permissions
Desktop only for now - terminal support coming soon

slides.heading: Ideas to <accent>Automate</accent> Today
slides.body:
- Daily standup prep at 6am
- Weekly code review summaries
- Auto-triage GitHub issues
- Morning news and research briefs
- Project health checks every hour
